notes: College of Arts and Humanities' English Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (Fall/Spring cells for four years run together), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Term placement here follows the plan's clearly-legible signals: the two early 'ENGL 1xx-2xx' placeholder slots (Year 1 Fall and Spring), ENGL301 in Year 2 Fall (the department's recommended sophomore-year placement), 'Historical Course #1-4' spread Year 1 through Year 3 Fall in the order the plan lists them, 'Track #1-4' spread Year 3 Fall through Year 4 Fall, and remaining Elective slots in Years 3-4. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.

The two 'ENGL 1xx-2xx' placeholder slots are filled with ENGL243 (assigned to Historical Studies) and ENGL244 (assigned to the Track), both real 2xx courses from the Academic Catalog course list the main session supplied for plan slots -- matching the catalog's cap of at most two 1xx/2xx courses toward the major (catalog rule 1, not itself enforced by the engine; see reviewNotes). Neither is asserted to actually be a Creative Writing workshop; see the Program's reviewNotes on the track's unencoded workshop/Creative Form and Theory shape.

Historical Studies (4 courses, no course-to-period list in either source) filled with ENGL243, ENGL310, ENGL327, ENGL416, all from the Academic Catalog course list the main session supplied for plan slots.

Element 3: Creative Writing Track (4 courses / 12 credits, no course-to-workshop-type list in either source) filled with ENGL244, ENGL334, ENGL345, ENGL432, all from the Academic Catalog course list the main session supplied for plan slots.
Element 4: Electives (9 credits) filled with ENGL376, ENGL444, ENGL448, all from the Academic Catalog course list the main session supplied for plan slots.

Of the 12 ENGL courses used, 2 are 2xx-level (ENGL243, ENGL244) and 4 are 4xx-level (ENGL416, ENGL432, ENGL444, ENGL448), matching the plan's own footnote ('only two of the 12 ENGL courses may be taken at 1xx-2xx level, and at least four of the 12 ENGL courses must be taken at the 4xx level') even though the engine does not check this aggregate rule.
